title: Checkout times out after payment authorization
description: Some shoppers see a timeout after payment is authorized and may retry checkout.

title: Session expires during account sign-in
description: A subset of users are returned to the login screen while signing in after a long idle period.

title: Profile avatar is incorrectly aligned on mobile
description: The profile image is shifted on smaller Android and iOS screens. No data is affected.

title: Order API intermittently returns a server error
description: The order endpoint occasionally returns HTTP 500 under high request volume.
